<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Ensure admin user exists with known credentials
if (!username_exists('admin')) {
    $user_id = wp_create_user('admin', 'password', 'admin@example.com');
    if (!is_wp_error($user_id)) {
        $user = get_user_by('id', $user_id);
        $user->remove_role('subscriber');
        $user->add_role('administrator');
    }
}

// Initialize plugin settings
update_option('altolith_settings', [
    'version' => '1.0.0',
    'providers' => [],
    'provider_types' => [],
]);

// Create test post for E2E tests
if (!get_page_by_title('Test Post', OBJECT, 'post')) {
    wp_insert_post([
        'post_title' => 'Test Post',
        'post_content' => 'This is a test post for E2E testing.',
        'post_status' => 'publish',
        'post_author' => 1,
        'post_type' => 'post',
    ]);
}

// Create test page
if (!get_page_by_title('Test Page', OBJECT, 'page')) {
    wp_insert_post([
        'post_title' => 'Test Page',
        'post_content' => 'This is a test page for E2E testing.',
        'post_status' => 'publish',
        'post_author' => 1,
        'post_type' => 'page',
    ]);
}

echo 'WordPress Playground environment configured for Altolith E2E testing';
